第39章 永恒领域的眷顾-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

许默眼睛都红了。

“干得漂亮！你这手气，神了！”方芸也是兴奋的满脸潮红。

许默突然揽住她的肩膀，对着她的脸蛋狠狠亲了一口。

方芸推开他，嫌弃的擦自己的脸，但并没有苛责。

许默已经迫不及待地将手探入光芒之中。

第一件，是一件设计图纸。

【家具·储藏柜】

【效果：可储存任何物品，延缓消耗品腐败速度，缓慢恢复衣物类装备物品的耐久度。】

许默这下真是要疯了。

“这他妈真是好东西，等把它造出来日常装备损耗就完全不担心了，还可以延缓食物腐败的时间！”

第二件抓出来的，是一本散发着微弱光芒的老书。

【书籍·恢复药剂配方】

【效果：习得后，可炼制恢复生命值的药剂，大幅度促进伤口愈合。】

方芸的眼睛瞬间亮得惊人，激动得连连搓手，这简直是逆天改命的神器。

如果再出现昨天夜里的极限战斗，他们就可以提前制作回血药，作战续航能力大大提升。

许默也是长长地舒出了一口浊气，心里终于松了一口气。

在这缺医少药的地方，这种能持续产出回血道具的配方，就是绝对的神药，其价值绝对远超一把极品武器。

保命的东西，谁不想要！

最后一件，更是神奇。

它是一个被亚克力塑料密封在盒子的锈旧机器人。

【失落遗物·矿工瓦力】

【攻击力：40】

【特性一·传送：瓦力拥有可以传送到绑定空间的采集枪，大幅增加采集作业效率。】

【特性二·守卫：瓦力被植入了保卫家园的底层系统，可以防止在营地区域内，自动进行防御。】

许默轻轻敲了敲亚克力盒子，里面的机器人立刻暴躁的撞击外壳。

这三件物品，一件储物装备，一件快速恢复，一件守家采集，直接补齐短板。

就像是特意为他们现在处境定制的一般。

方芸咽了口唾沫。

“这……这真的只是巧合吗？”

许默眯起眼睛，在宝箱最底部，还有一张羊皮纸卷。

Xu Mo's eyes were red.

"Well done! Your luck is amazing!" Fang Yun also flushed with excitement.

Xu Mo suddenly put his arms around her shoulders and kissed her hard on the face.

Fang Yun pushed him away and wiped her face in disgust, but did not criticize him harshly.

Xu Mo couldn't wait to put his hand into the light.

The first thing is a design drawing.

【Furniture·Storage Cabinet】

[Effect: Can store any items, slow down the decay rate of consumables, and slowly restore the durability of clothing and equipment items.】

Xu Mo was really going crazy now.

"This is really a damn good thing. Once you build it, you won't have to worry about daily equipment wear and tear. It can also delay the time of food spoilage!"

The second thing he grabbed was an old book with a faint light.

[Book·Recovery Potion Formula]

[Effect: After learning it, you can refine potions that restore health and greatly promote wound healing.】

Fang Yun's eyes suddenly brightened up astonishingly, and she was so excited that she rubbed her hands together. This was simply a divine tool that could change one's fate.

If the extreme battle last night happens again, they can make blood-restoring medicine in advance, greatly improving their combat endurance.

Xu Mo also let out a long sigh of relief, finally feeling relieved.

In this place where there is a shortage of medical treatment and medicine, this formula that can continuously produce blood-restoring props is an absolute miracle medicine, and its value is definitely far more than a top-quality weapon.

Who doesn’t want life-saving things?

The last one is even more magical.

It's a rusty old robot sealed in a box with acrylic plastic.

[Lost Relic·Miner Wall-E]

[Attack power: 40]

[Feature 1: Teleportation: Wall-E has a collection gun that can be teleported to the bound space, which greatly increases the efficiency of collection operations.】

[Feature 2: Guard: Wall-E has been implanted with the underlying system to protect his home, which can prevent automatic defense in the camp area.】

Xu Mo lightly knocked on the acrylic box, and the robot inside immediately hit the outer shell angrily.

These three items, one for storage equipment, one for quick recovery, and one for home collection, directly make up for the shortcomings.

It's like it was specially customized for their current situation.

Fang Yun swallowed.

"Is this...is this really just a coincidence?"

Xu Mo squinted his eyes and saw that there was a parchment roll at the bottom of the treasure box.
